meals.title: Boerewors Braai with Pap and Tomato Smoor
meals.why: Traditional boerewors is R99.99/kg (R89.99 with a Checkers loyalty card), and the 10kg maize meal at R84.99 makes pap for many meals.
method: Light the fire and braai the boerewors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Soften sliced onion and garlic in oil in a pot. Add the chopped tomatoes, chilli, salt and a pinch of sugar, and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Boil 4 cups of water with salt. Stir in about 2 cups of maize meal, cover and steam on low for 20 minutes, stirring once or twice, until crumbly.
Serve the wors with pap and the tomato smoor.

meals.title: Roast Butternut Soup with Paprika Cream
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg, so a big pot of soup costs very little, and it's the vegetarian meal of the week.
method: Peel and cube about 1kg of butternut. Toss with oil, salt and half the paprika, then roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Soften chopped onion and garlic in a pot, then add the roasted butternut and 750ml of stock. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Stir in most of the cream and season to taste.
Warm the paninis in the oven. Serve the soup with a swirl of cream and a sprinkle of paprika, with the paninis for dipping.

meals.title: Creamy Paprika Chicken Livers on Toast
meals.why: A 500g pack of chicken livers is only R21.50, so this feeds the family for next to nothing and is on the table in about 20 minutes once thawed.
method: Thaw the livers in the fridge in the morning, then drain and pat dry.
Fry sliced onion and garlic in oil until golden. Add the livers and cook over high heat for 6-8 minutes until just cooked through.
Stir in the paprika, salt and pepper. Turn the heat to low and stir in 3-4 tablespoons of yoghurt, with a squeeze of lemon if you like.
Toast the bread and spoon the livers over.

meals.title: Classic Cottage Pie
meals.why: Lean beef mince is R109.99/kg (R99.99 with a Checkers loyalty card), and the 2kg of potatoes and 2L of milk make a cheap, filling oven bake.
method: Peel and boil about 1kg of potatoes until soft. Mash with Rama, a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Brown 500g of mince with onion, garlic and grated carrot in a large pan.
Add the chopped tomatoes, a stock cube, herbs and a little water. Simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish and top with the mash, then rough up the surface with a fork.
Bake at 190°C for 25-30 minutes until golden.

meals.title: Paprika Chicken and Butternut Traybake
meals.why: The 2kg frozen braai pack is R94.99 and roasts well alongside cheap butternut, with a single tray and little washing up.

uses.item: No Name Frozen Chicken Braai Pack 2kg
Knorr Aromat Original All Purpose Seasoning Spice Trio Refill 200g

method: Thaw the chicken fully in the fridge, then pat dry. Heat the oven to 200°C.
Rub the chicken with oil, paprika, Aromat, crushed garlic and lemon juice.
Cut butternut into wedges and quarter the red onion. Spread everything on a large baking tray.
Roast for 45-50 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Serve with a green salad or steamed veg.

meals.title: Bacon, Potato and Gouda Frittata
meals.why: Eggs are only R64.99 for 18, and one 200g pack of bacon plus a few potatoes turns them into a meal for the whole family.
method: Dice 2-3 potatoes and boil or microwave for 8 minutes until just tender. Drain well.
Fry chopped bacon and onion in an ovenproof pan, then add the potatoes and brown lightly.
Whisk 8 eggs with salt and pepper and pour over the pan. Tear in Gouda slices.
Cook on low for 5 minutes until the edges set, then finish under a hot grill for 5 minutes until puffed and golden.
Slice and serve with a tomato and cucumber salad.
